caso.texto:
Paper Works posts order-organisation examples. A post received 200 views, 20 interactions and four application questions; only two people requested demos. The rep labelled all 20 opportunities and exported profiles. There is no permission to use client images.

A US craft-supply business attracts independent retailers through educational posts. One retailer asks about compatibility while another needs existing-customer support. Treat those conversations differently; public engagement is not a buying-project register.

projeto.instrucoes: Create a social-selling plan with ten content ideas, three interaction replies and meeting-invitation criteria; explain denominators and correct the record.
projeto.gabarito: Interactions/views=10%; demo requests/views=1%, with no causal claim. There are not 20 established opportunities. Separate questions, support and evaluation. Teach useful tasks without client exposure, respect community rules and avoid convenience exports.

avaliacao_basica.observacao: Não substitui banco profissional de 40 questões / Does not replace a 40-question professional bank

simulacao.instrucao_ator: Play the fictional buyer. Reveal supplied facts when asked; say you need to verify unknowns. Do not teach or score during dialogue. After three turns raise a timing or scope concern; in a second round request closure.
simulacao.instrucao_avaliador: Use only the transcript and rubric. Cite evidence, identify gaps and request human review for uncertain scores. Do not issue certificates or approve contracts.
